title: Service Baselines
reward: Learn that normality belongs to a service and route family.
knowledge: Baseline by host, route family, method and time context.
n8n, LightBI, Ghost and infrastructure endpoints need different priors.
Authenticated application navigation may contain security-sounding route words without being secret-file probing.
Static assets, APIs, health endpoints and login routes have different rhythms.
A baseline is revisable evidence, never a whitelist.
next_requires: Avoid global-normal and word-only classification errors.
